key_insight: A closed-loop search calibrates atomistic GaAs growth kinetics directly from experimental growth data, reducing reliance on costly DFT-derived rate parameters.
engineering_relevance: The framework turns routine MOCVD growth measurements into a mechanistically interpretable model that could support process optimization.
method: Simulate atomistic deposition events with kinetic Monte Carlo.
Use Monte Carlo Tree Search to calibrate kinetic rate parameters against experimental growth data.
Steer the search using each parameter’s degree of rate control.
evidence_signal: For GaAs MOCVD, the calibrated model captures the measured temperature dependence of growth rate and recovers three known kinetic regimes with changing rate-determining steps.
watch_item: Calibration depends on the chosen reaction-event model, and the abstract does not report quantitative errors or validation beyond GaAs.
paper_title: Atomistic Insights into MOCVD Growth of GaAs using a Closed Loop Autonomous System Combining Directed Reinforcement Learning and Kinetic Monte Carlo Simulations
